root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the chunk clamp condition must treat negative `mdif` the same as zero before the helper may fall through into the AVX2 load path
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the inner 16-pixel chunk guard, the clamp/store path must be selected whenever `mdif <= 0`, not only when `mdif == 0`, before execution may proceed into the `_mm_loadu_si128` pair.
root_cause_criterion.description: For the witnessed negative-distance chunk, the vulnerable original evaluates its actual guard `mdif == 0` as false even though the required nonpositive guard `mdif <= 0` is true, so the same chunk falls through into the unchecked load pair. The fixed version makes the actual guard match the required nonpositive condition at this root-cause line.

nodes.state: At the unchecked `_mm_loadu_si128((__m128i *)(above + base + j))` pair, the first load starts from a chunk index strictly greater than `max_base_x`, so the sink consumes top-reference samples beyond the computed valid span for this 64xN predictor.

edges.relation: The same `base + j` chunk index whose negative-distance case is misclassified at the root guard is used unchanged as the starting index of the unchecked AVX2 load pair.

The stack-backed `above_row` alias passed out of `build_intra_predictors_high()` is the same `above` pointer consumed by the unchecked AVX2 load pair, tying the sink back to ASan's overflowed `above_data` stack object.
